records.Name: Employer Hub for a community college
records.Challenge__c: Several departments at a community college worked with the same employer partners, each from its own inbox and spreadsheet. Partners repeated themselves, and nobody could see the whole relationship. Leadership had no shared numbers for engagement, sponsorship or hiring.
records.Solution__c: One Employer Hub in Salesforce captures every inquiry once, triages it and routes it to the right department. Partner engagements, job postings, sponsorships and letters of support sit on the partner's account. Operations and executive dashboards report from the same records.
records.Business_Value__c: Employer partners get one front door and a faster answer. Departments stop duplicating outreach and can see each other's work with a partner. Leadership can report on the employer relationship as a whole for the first time.
